title: FPMarkets Server-to-New-York DST Mismatch Session
question: When the frozen FPMarkets server-to-New-York clock gap contracts from seven hours to six during the two US/Europe daylight-saving mismatch intervals, do native portfolio births show a material and directionally coherent change in full-lifecycle stressed R and stop incidence relative to aligned-clock births of the same strategy and fresh period?
hypothesis: Because frozen strategy evaluation hours are server-wall economic variables and are not remapped to New York time, both mismatch intervals move them one New York wall-clock hour later. A genuine session-clock effect should therefore appear with the same economic direction in spring and autumn.
why_now: After closing Program 2 Unit 041, the whole-map comparison selected the only still-underrepresented Program 3. This deterministic session contract is independent of event-release outcomes, Unit 040 exit thresholds and the Unit 039 lot seed.

bundle_rotation.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not open a nearby DST subwindow, transition-day, weekday, holiday or clock-shift successor automatically.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

clock_contract.fpmarkets_summer: UTC+3 from 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday in March inclusive through 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday in October exclusive; UTC+2 otherwise.
clock_contract.new_york_summer: UTC-4 from 07:00 UTC on the second Sunday in March inclusive through 06:00 UTC on the first Sunday in November exclusive; UTC-5 otherwise.
clock_contract.aligned_state: FPMarkets server minus New York wall time is seven hours.
clock_contract.mismatch_state: FPMarkets server remains UTC+2 while New York is UTC-4, so the gap is six hours and a fixed server-wall evaluation occurs one New York hour later.
clock_contract.SPRING_US_AHEAD: New York summer start inclusive through FPMarkets/Europe summer start exclusive.
clock_contract.AUTUMN_EU_BEHIND: FPMarkets/Europe summer end inclusive through New York summer end exclusive.
clock_contract.implementation: Convert each recorded server-wall birth through Windows FLE Standard Time to UTC, then classify with the exact transition rules above and cross-check Eastern Standard Time offsets. Market-week births avoid ambiguous Sunday transition instants.
clock_contract.prohibited_shortcut: Do not classify by a fixed calendar-date list, month, week number or seven-hour ET/server shortcut.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Admitted birth timestamp, strategy and fresh period only. No close value, stressed R, stop result, mismatch-conditioned outcome association or verdict was accessed.
pre_outcome_feasibility.structural_period_absence: P1 begins after the 2022 spring interval and P4 ends before the 2026 autumn interval. Spring therefore spans P1-P4; autumn is judged only over P1-P3 and its P4 zero is never imputed or failed.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a persisted-state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed close-before-birth event precedence, then source path and line.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores one positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with that active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle. value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks stop incidence.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.state_assignment: Classify exactly once from birth server time into SPRING_US_AHEAD, AUTUMN_EU_BEHIND or ALIGNED using clock_contract.
fixed_reconstruction.comparator: For every mismatch lifecycle, benchmark mean stressed_r and stop rate come from ALIGNED lifecycles of the same strategy and fresh period.

residuals.stressed_r_residual: mismatch lifecycle stressed_r minus its same-strategy same-period ALIGNED benchmark mean
residuals.stop_residual: mismatch lifecycle stop indicator minus its same-strategy same-period ALIGNED benchmark stop rate

fixed_reconstruction.aggregation: Report each mismatch variant's equal-lifecycle pooled, period and strategy raw outcomes and residuals. Do not pool spring and autumn until both independent variant gates are complete.

fixed_integrity_gate: The session clock source retains its declaration hash and still expresses the exact FPMarkets and New York transition rules; no source is modified.
All six economic files retain their listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.

Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594; no overlap, unmatched close, nonpositive planned risk or Passive pending fault is allowed.
Reconstruct exact frozen stressed net 407.0477 USD and exactly 206 stop exits.
Reproduce exact state, period, strategy and aligned-cell densities frozen in pre_outcome_feasibility.
Every ALIGNED strategy-period benchmark cell contains at least 22 lifecycles and finite stressed R and stop rate.

SPRING_US_AHEAD: At least 20 mismatch lifecycles in each of P1-P4.
All six strategies have at least eight mismatch lifecycles pooled.
AUTUMN_EU_BEHIND: At least seven mismatch lifecycles in each of P1-P3; P4 is structurally outside scope.
At least four strategies have at least five mismatch lifecycles pooled.

SPRING_US_AHEAD: Absolute pooled mean stressed_r residual is at least 0.10R.
At least three of four period mean stressed_r residuals share the pooled nonzero sign.
Absolute pooled mean stop residual is at least 0.05.
At least three of four period mean stop residuals share the pooled nonzero sign.
At least four of six strategy mean stressed_r residuals share the pooled sign.
Economic coherence: positive stressed_r residual requires negative stop residual, or negative stressed_r residual requires positive stop residual.
AUTUMN_EU_BEHIND: Absolute pooled mean stressed_r residual is at least 0.10R.
All three P1-P3 period mean stressed_r residuals share the pooled nonzero sign.
Absolute pooled mean stop residual is at least 0.05.
All three P1-P3 period mean stop residuals share the pooled nonzero sign.
At least three of the four density-supported strategies Cross, Passive, RC16 and Return share the pooled stressed_r sign.
Economic coherence: positive stressed_r residual requires negative stop residual, or negative stressed_r residual requires positive stop residual.
fixed_variant_information_gate.interpretation: Each variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. A near threshold, one season or one strategy never survives alone.

requirements: Both SPRING_US_AHEAD and AUTUMN_EU_BEHIND pass their complete variant gates.
The two pooled stressed_r residuals share the same nonzero sign.
The two pooled stop residuals share the same nonzero sign.
The shared stressed_r and stop directions remain economically coherent.
fixed_bundle_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later independently named New-York-aligned session-clock Proxy question. Unit 042 selects no time shift, signal, order, filter, size, stop, exit, EA or Live behavior, and the retained question cannot open automatically.
fixed_bundle_gate.failure_action: Close with no DST session-clock field. Do not rescue with transition-day removal, week expansion, spring/autumn pooling, weekday, holiday, strategy subset, entry hour, New York session label or alternate DST library.

verdict_rules.success: PASS_ONE_NEW_YORK_ALIGNED_SESSION_CLOCK_PROXY_QUESTION when integrity passes and both variants plus the cross-variant bundle pass every frozen gate.
verdict_rules.failure: NO_SERVER_NEW_YORK_DST_MISMATCH_SESSION_FIELD_PASSED when integrity passes but either variant or the bundle fails.
verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_CLOCK_INPUT_OR_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_SESSION_VERDICT when any source, input, lifecycle, clock-state or aligned-benchmark integrity gate fails.
verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_NO_SESSION_SEED only if integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition prevents the fixed residual association from being interpreted without changing the contract.

stop_rules: Fill the exact frozen session-clock source hash, then commit and push this declaration before accessing any mismatch-conditioned close value, stressed R, stop association or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six immutable files.
Do not run MT5, compile or modify MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Do not alter a DST interval, pool the variants before separate judgment or add a transition day, weekday, holiday, strategy subset, entry hour or alternate comparator.
Close the family after the one result and recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before any retained seed or nearby session question.
